'''Climbing fern''' was a species of flora found on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TEA" /> Two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, they draped from [[Massassi tree/Legends|massassi trees]], [[szechual]] and cliff faces. They had finely defined leaves of green and yellow.
